chapterInfo.content:
2
Aduane afɔdeɛ
1Na sɛ obi de aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE a, n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no nyɛ esiam, na ɔngu so ngo, na ɔmfa ohwamfufuo nto so. 2Na ɔmfa mmrɛ Aaron mma no, asɔfoɔ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa esiam ne ngo no nsa mama, ne ohwamfufuo no nyinaa, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ. Ɛyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE. 3Na aduane afɔdeɛ no mu deɛ ɛbɛka no nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea, AWURADE gya mu akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ne no.
4Na sɛ wode aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ a wɔato no fononoo mu bi reba a, fa esiam apiti a wɔde ngo afɔre taterɛ ne apiti ɔfam a wɔagu so ngo bra. 5Na sɛ w’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔakye no dadeɛ so a, ma no nyɛ esiam apiti a wɔde ngo afɔre; 6bubu mu asinasini, na hwie ngo gu so, aduane afɔdeɛ ne no.
7Na sɛ w’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ kukuo mu aduane afɔdeɛ a, fa esiam ne ngo yɛ. 8Na fa aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔde nnoɔma yi ayɛ no brɛ AWURADE; na wɔde brɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no a, ɔmfa mmra afɔrebukyia no ho. 9Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nyi ayɛyɛdeɛ no so nkaeɛ adeɛ no, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so; ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE ne no. 10Na aduane afɔdeɛ no nkaeɛ nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea; akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron a ɛfiri AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ mu ne no.
11 # Lew 6.7 Aduane afɔdeɛ a mode bɛbrɛ AWURADE no nyinaa, mommfa mmɔreka nnyɛ; na monnhye mmɔreka biara ne ɛwoɔ biara sɛ ogya afɔdeɛ mmma AWURADE. 12#Num 18.12 Momfa nnoɔma yi mmrɛ AWURADE sɛ aba a ɛdi kan mu afɔrebɔdeɛ, nanso wɔmmfa bi mmma afɔrebukyia no so sɛ ɛmmɛyi hwa hwanhwam. 13#Mar 9.49 Na w’aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ nyinaa, to mu nkyene, na mma wo Nyankopɔn apam nkyene mmpa w’aduane afɔdeɛ mu; fa nkyene ka w’ayɛyɛdeɛ nyinaa ho.
14Na sɛ wode aba a ɛdi kan ayɛyɛdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE a, fa aburoo mmɛtem a wɔato no ogya mu atutu apɔn ho yɛ w’aba a ɛdi kan mu ayɛyɛdeɛ; 15na fa ngo gu so, na fa ohwamfufuo to so; aduane afɔdeɛ ne no. 16Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye aburoo mfuamfua a wɔapɔn ho no bi ne ngo no bi ne ohwamfufuo no nyinaa sɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ; ɛyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ ma AWURADE.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
